Vengeful.name: Vengeful
Vengeful.description:
🌑 You remember every wrong done to you, and you do not forgive.

🔎 You track people down patiently; a grudge keeps you going when nothing else would.
⚠️ Revenge blinds you: you chase it into traps and past better chances.
⚠️ Enemies know a slight will pull you off course.
🔀 If you are also Calm, the grudge is quiet, patient and never goes away.

📈 Grants: Investigation +5
Vengeful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is vengeful: they remember every wrong, do not forgive and will track a person down for as long as it takes; the grudge keeps them going. Weakness: revenge blinds them, pulling them into traps and past better chances, and enemies learn a slight will pull them off course. If the character is also Calm, the grudge is quiet and patient. The narrator lets old wrongs come back into reach; whether to take revenge is the player's decision.
